title: A2UI Spectra Conformance Test Suite Schema
description: JSON schema validating the conformance test suites under conformance/.

ValidateTurnRecordTest.description: Validates one turn record fixture against the turn record schema of the suite's version.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: What the test verifies. For a case that must fail, the reason it fails.

fixture.description: Path of the turn record fixture, relative to conformance/.

expectError.description: Present when the fixture must fail validation.

details.description: Each detail matches at least one error the validator reports.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the failing value in the fixture.

code.description: The JSON Schema keyword that failed, as JSON Schema 2020-12's output format names it.
